name: The same number of senators voted for and against a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2018-03-19.252.1) that the following parts of the bill remain unchanged: schedules 3, 4 and 9 to 14; subsection 42AI(3) in item 1 of schedule 15; and schedule 17. This means the vote didn't pass. However, this vote was [later taken again](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/divisions/senate/2018-03-19/7) to allow two other senators to take part in it.
